title: Variable Touch Verdict
description: EXECUTE-stage hard-gate artifact. Output of variable-touch-guard (computed by variable_touch_guard.py). BLOCK if any touched variable is studied or frozen; PASS if only controlled variables are touched. Verdict is derived from violations, never set by hand — the allOf forces BLOCK when violations is non-empty.

verdict.description: PASS if no studied/frozen variables were touched; BLOCK if any were. Derived from violations by the tool.

violations.description: Human-readable violation strings naming the branch/session and the offending variable. Empty on PASS.

checked_against.description: Optional reference to the experiment_matrix the guard checked against.

touched.description: The full list of variables that were touched (from the debug_session or experiment_tree branches).

studied.description: The studied variables from the experiment_matrix (copied for auditability).

frozen.description: The frozen variables from the experiment_matrix (copied for auditability).
